name: latched-clear-straight-sustain-v2

factor.behavioral_change: Extend the already emitted launch maximum0.11 to the inherited mid and low pedal branches only after every clear-straight guard passes and no obstacle-side latch remains.
factor.exact_predicate: base gas is positive, base brake is zero, exact straight is true, current obstacle is None, abs(previous steer)<=0.07, and _obstacle_side==0.0 after inherited detector state update

frozen: cruise48, target speed and EMA, curve formula/floor, obstacle targets, parent compound target30 and every brake threshold/value
MAX_GAS0.08, existing maximum emitted gas0.11 and MAX_BRAKE0.28
obstacle detector, side/miss latch and miss limit4; the candidate only reads the inherited post-update latch
straight classifier, steering, slew, urgency, preview, obstacle priority, invalid/lost behavior and all controller state
model.pt, DrQ, explicit export, HAIC policy, official environment, active padding study, user artifacts and root submission.zip

synthetic: Exact and nextafter speed boundaries40,45 and49: full branch and overspeed brake exact; only mid/low clear-straight gas changes to registered values.
Full act closes both signs of previous-steer exact0.07 and nextafter-outside boundaries.

After a detected obstacle, all four latched detector-miss frames and any reacquisition are complete-action/state exact; only the fifth consecutive miss, which clears the inherited latch, may enable sustain.
Curves, previews, current straight/curved obstacles, compound target30, invalid input, road loss and reset remain complete-action/state exact.

A seeded randomized differential includes clear, curve, obstacle and preloaded latch states; any difference must satisfy every registered predicate, affect gas only, remain<=0.11 and preserve all state exactly.
The class adds no instance field and reset remains deterministic.
regression: All prior corridor, inference and local contract tests pass.
Bare state-dict routing selects only the new final subclass; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.

A temporary package with exact candidate agent.py and unchanged model.pt passes static interface/import, initialization, reset, action, latch-sequence, latency and size smoke without overwriting root submission.zip.

future_environment_gate.required_before_claim: Restore governance, then preregister unused geometry seeds across multiple track IDs. Require no finish-rate, DNF, collision, damage or worst-progress regression before comparing jointly finished lap times.
future_environment_gate.interpretation: This factor is intentionally too narrow to be represented as sufficient for low-20-second laps.

abort: Any detector-miss frame with a nonzero obstacle latch differs from control.
Any curve, current obstacle, brake, steering, target, detector state, invalid/lost action or non-bare route differs.
Emitted gas exceeds0.11, new state is added, or the inherited latch behavior changes.
Any track ID, seed, coordinate, time, progress or memorized map condition is introduced.
Any environment execution, training, completion/lap-time claim, submission or SOTA action occurs while governance documents remain absent.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
The competition website is inaccessible and no fixed official map list, public evaluation seeds or official target time is available.
Only static and synthetic validation is authorized; the candidate remains INCOMPARABLE.
